chapter_title: Concerning the Nourishment of the Person, for there are Powers in it [ ... / ... ]
chapter_note: This short chapter is dominated by systematic cosmological-physiological teaching (body as a purification apparatus; enumerated inner powers; cleansing/expulsion; transmigration mechanics). The only clear later material is a brief dialogue/frame attribution at the start of ¶1, which can be cleanly removed without damaging the teaching sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: daily to the body of the person [ ... ] there are two hundred and fifty thousand seals in it [ ... ] there are another two hundred and fifty thousand rulers [ ... ] they are cleansed and purified and enter [ ... ] by the voice, by the word, and by the [ ... ... ] quiet with the silence at the time when his heart [ ... ... ] of God the Father.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed opening hagiographic/frame attribution: "[Once again] speaks [ ... ] exists [ ... ]" (dialogue/editorial container language; not part of the impersonal system description).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core teaching is the impersonal, enumerative physiological-cosmological mechanism (seals/rulers; cleansing/purification; entry by voice/word/silence). The opening "Once again speaks..." is a compilation-frame marker; the remaining material stays within cosmic mechanics rather than exhortation or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, the twelve [ ... ... ] rulers that belong to the Darkness shall be swept out outside in wandering and in transmigration [ ... ... ] some of them [ ... through] this transmigration, and others among them shall be brought back.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological process-description (twelve rulers of Darkness; expulsion; wandering/transmigration/return) with no citation formulas, no audience address, and no institutional application—characteristic of the older teaching stratum.
